agent.note: The two transcripts are agent sessions that invoked the skill once each to do the work. Four further Codex sessions, under codex_plugin_forms, only checked which invocation forms load the skill. No other session produced evidence for this release.

edit_note: The transcripts are rendered from the clients' raw JSON-lines output, which is not committed, plus each run's prompt file, which the raw output does not echo. The only edits are the replacements listed per run; each tool-call argument is cut at 4000 characters and each tool result at 1500. The outputs, prompts, and version files are committed byte for byte.

version_file.note: the client's --version output, captured just before the run

prompt_file.note: the exact request passed to the client; the renderer prints it under == prompt ==

invocations.started_note: both clients were started together, in parallel
invocations.invocation: /mechanical-summarize:mechanical-summarize Create a 50% deletion-only copy of weekly-update.md in this directory. Leave weekly-update.md unchanged.
invocations.loaded_through: --plugin-dir pointing at an exact export of the input commit; claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode acceptEdits --add-dir /tmp --allowedTools with Bash prefixes for python3, wc, cat, ls, diff, sed, head, tail, grep, mktemp, and rm of /tmp/tmp.* paths. Commands outside that list (cp, sha256sum, cmp, echo) also ran; the event stream does not record what allowed them, and the maintainer's user-level hooks were active. Three compound commands were refused.
